parent_objective: design calibrated terminal-boundary history interventions over actual near-boundary rows
blocked_by: history interventions have not yet been run on calibrated terminal-boundary rows
supersedes: direct materialization of M1544 calibrated rows

public_gates: M1546 must design calibrated measured traces before interventions
M1546 must preserve P0 actor input contract
M1546 must separate history interventions from reset/zero-current controls
M1546 must keep materialization and training blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs calibrated terminal-boundary measured-pair interventions after M1544 source-window repair
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design skips measured response/context pair construction
stop if design weakens control separation or actor-input contract
stop after defining bounded intervention artifacts and thresholds
fallback_plan: route to implementation only if measured trace and pair gates are pre-registered
route to branch synthesis if calibrated rows are too narrow for pair construction
route to stop if the design would require materialization or training
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1545 admits calibrated intervention design after M1544 pass

admission_evidence: M1545 audited M1544 calibrated rows as sufficient for design-only intervention planning
allowed_updates: M1546 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: calibrated measured trace and pair construction are defined
intervention variants and controls are defined

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1546 is design only; future implementation must separate history effects from current-frame and reset/zero-current controls.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Design for calibrated decision and post-decision terminal-boundary rows.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If calibrated interventions are null or control dominated, record the result and route to audit/synthesis instead of weakening thresholds.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A calibrated terminal-boundary history-intervention design can test whether wrong-history or donor response/action history changes outcome on actual near-boundary rows while preserving controls and guardrails.
success_criteria: design defines calibrated measured trace reconstruction and pair gates
design defines history interventions, controls, and terminal-positive thresholds
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and training-corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: design treats M1544 calibration as history-necessity evidence
design skips matched scene/current-state pair construction
design routes directly to training promotion private holdout or materialization
decision_rule: M1546 passes if it designs calibrated terminal-boundary interventions without weakening pair matching, controls, or guardrails.
